Quezon Avenue, west Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq.qov.ph s. 202 OPINION NO. 30 HON. SOL F. MATUGAS Municipal Mayor General Luna, Surigao del Norte Dear Mayor Matugas: This refers to your letter dated December 6, 2023 with subject: Request for Legal Opinion on the denial of request for travel authority to attend the DILG sanctioned activity entitled Climate Change Reparations: "A Climate Justice Imperative" Round Table Discussion. Per your representation, the reason for the denial of your travel authority to attend the round table discussion as mentioned above is that you were not able to submit your request within three (3) days prior to the intended travel dates considering that time herein is of the essence. However, in a letter dated November 22, 2023 of Governor Robert Lyndon Barbers, two reasons for the denial of your travel authority were presented: (I) the request for issuance of travel order was received on November 22, 2023 which is less than three days prior to the intended travel dates; and (2) the said event offers both onsite and online options for attendance. It appears therefore, that, online platform is offered. Thus, we resolved. Foremost, we find Section 3 of Executive Order No. 77, series of 20191 enlightening, the same provides: Section 3. Authorized Official travel. (a) Official local or foreign travels and assignments under this Order shall cover only those which meet the following criteria: (i) it is essential to the effective performance of an official or employee's mandates or functions; (ii) it is required to meet the needs of the department, bureau or office, or there is substantial benefit to be derived by the State; (iii) the presence of the official or employee is critical to the outcome of the meeting, conference, seminar, consultation or any official activity to be attended; and (iv) the projected expenses are not excessive or involve minimum expenditure. (b) All officials authorized to approve local or overseas travels are required, as far as practicable, to minimize travel cost. Hence. all forms of communications. 1 Entitled: PRESCRIBING THE RULES AND REGULATIONS AND RATES OF EXPENSES AND ALLOWANCES FOR OFFICIAL LOCAL AND FOREIGN TRAVELS OF GOVERNMENT PERSONNEL "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

such as. but not limited to teleconferencinq and videoconferencinq or submission of briefs and position papers. as alternatives to travel. must be explored, provided, these do not compromise national security and confidentiality of official communications. Xxx (Emphasis ours) Henceforth, we are of the considered view that the denial of your travel order has legal basis. May we further note that Executive Order No. 77, s. 2019 equally applies to official local travel of personnel of local government units2. We hope to have addressed your concern accordingly.
